items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 1:1
items.html: (To the question) Because there is there a level of Phase Two from the phase of clothing, which is the phase of Israel Saba, and Yeshsut is the phase of HaVaYaH of SAG. (p. 485, entry "and behold")
